items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: And we had some entertainers on there. Benny Fields, Benny Davis, Jack Salisbury, Charlie Thorpe. And I had the band.

ctx.x: Then he quit playing. Yeah. So, then I ran into, we went to a place. He put me down to a place called the Windcliffe Inn. First out to Al Trendy's in Chicago, then down to the Windcliffe Inn. And we had some entertainers on there. Benny Fields, Benny Davis, Jack Salisbury, Charlie Thorpe. And I had the band. And we, it got to be a hot spot too.
